faq_heading: New construction in South Sardis: your questions answered

faq.q: What have houses in South Sardis sold for?
faq.a: 147 houses sold in South Sardis at a median of $895,000, with the middle half between $792,500 and $1,097,500.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in South Sardis?
faq.a: In South Sardis, houses were quickest at 19 days at a median, and townhomes slowest at 20 days.

faq.q: Which homes in South Sardis are the newest?
faq.a: Of the homes that resold in South Sardis, townhomes had the newest median build year, 2008.

items.t: South Sardis: 147 houses sold at a median of $895,000, with the middle half between $792,500 and $1,097,500. The median house took 19 days to sell and closed at 98.0% of list.
43 townhomes sold in South Sardis at a median of $650,000 (middle half $582,500 to $707,500). A typical townhome in South Sardis spent 20 days on the market and closed at 98.4% of the asking price.

blocks.text: 4 Condos also sold in South Sardis, too few for a median to mean anything, so no price is shown for them.
Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How South Sardis compares with the rest of Sardis

items.t: Of 7 Sardis sub-areas with 5 or more house sales, South Sardis ranks 4th highest at $895,000; the range is $667,000 (Vedder Crossing) to $1,192,500 (Garrison Crossing). Sardis East Vedder ($870,000) sits just below and Sardis West Vedder ($937,500) sits just above.
Townhomes in South Sardis have the highest median of the 6 Sardis sub-areas, $650,000, ahead of Promontory at $620,000; the lowest is Sardis West Vedder at $389,950.

blocks.text: By build year, townhomes are the newest homes selling in South Sardis (median 2008) and houses the oldest (median 1997), a gap of 11 years.
